title: The export model: selling to the world
goal: Say what Latin American countries sold abroad between 1870 and 1914 and who paid for it, using relative clauses.

items: Say what the export model was and when it grew.
Say who bought the exports and where the capital came from.
Use relative clauses with *que* to say which products and which countries.
I can say what the export model was and when it grew.
I can name what several countries exported.
I can say who bought the exports and where the capital came from.
I can use relative clauses with *que* to say which products and which countries.
